ruleEvaluations.description: Entry bar must exist in the training chart.
Entry, stop, and take profit must be ordered correctly for the chosen side.
Symbol must be allowed by the contract scope.
Timeframe must be allowed by the contract scope.
Side must be allowed by the contract.
Entry must happen after the Fib retracement extreme is established.
Long: entry must be at or below the 50% Fib level. Short: entry must be at or above.
Take profit must be beyond entry in the trade direction.
Long: stop below the Fib swing low. Short: stop above the Fib swing high.
Trade must offer at least 2R reward-to-risk.
Per-trade price risk must remain under 8%.
